name: get_earthquakes
title: Recent earthquakes
description: Earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or more from the USGS feed for the last 24 hours, strongest first. Optionally limited to an area and a minimum magnitude.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_active_fires
title: Active fires
description: Satellite fire detections from NASA FIRMS in the last 24 hours within an area, most intense (fire radiative power) first.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_recent_launches
title: Recent launches
description: Orbital launches from Launch Library 2 over the last 30 days, newest first, with provider, rocket, pad, mission and outcome.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: aircraft_in_area
title: Aircraft in an area
description: Aircraft currently reported inside an area, nearest the center first. Optionally military aircraft only, airborne only, or within an altitude band.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

military.description: Use the military aircraft feed instead of the general feed.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: find_aircraft
title: Find an aircraft
description: Find aircraft currently reported anywhere by callsign, ICAO 24-bit address or registration. Registrations are known only for aircraft in the military feed.

icao24.description: ICAO 24-bit address as six hex characters, such as "a1b2c3".

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_aircraft_track
title: Aircraft track
description: Recent positions of one aircraft by ICAO 24-bit address, oldest first. Long tracks are evenly thinned to at most 200 points.

icao24.description: ICAO 24-bit address as six hex characters, such as "a1b2c3".

military.description: Use the military aircraft feed instead of the general feed.

name: get_aircraft_info
title: Aircraft type and route
description: Look up an aircraft type and registration by ICAO 24-bit address, and a flight route by callsign, from adsbdb. Give either or both.

icao24.description: ICAO 24-bit address as six hex characters, such as "a1b2c3".

name: vessels_in_area
title: Vessels in an area
description: Ships currently reported by AIS inside an area, nearest the center first, optionally filtered by vessel type.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

type.description: Vessel type to match, such as "tanker" or "cargo".

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: find_vessel
title: Find a vessel
description: Find ships currently reported anywhere by MMSI, IMO number or name. Names match when they contain the given text.

mmsi.description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity, such as "366999712".

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_vessel_track
title: Vessel track
description: Recent positions of one ship by MMSI, oldest first. Long tracks are evenly thinned to at most 200 points.

mmsi.description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity, such as "366999712".

name: next_satellite_pass
title: Next satellite pass
description: When a satellite next rises over an observer, with rise, peak and set times, peak elevation, rise direction and naked-eye visibility. Defaults to the International Space Station.

location.description: A place name, or lat and lon.

satellite.description: Satellite name or NORAD catalog number (default the ISS).

visible_only.description: Only passes visible to the naked eye.

name: satellites_overhead
title: Satellites overhead
description: Satellites in a group that are above an observer right now, highest first, with elevation and direction.

location.description: A place name, or lat and lon.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: find_cctv_cameras
title: Public cameras in an area
description: Public traffic and city cameras in an area, nearest the center first. Use get_cctv_snapshot with a camera id to see its current view.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_cctv_snapshot
title: Camera snapshot
description: An image from one public camera, by the id from find_cctv_cameras. Street View fallback imagery is historical, not the current camera view; unknown frame provenance is explicit.

name: find_alpr_cameras
title: License plate reader cameras
description: Automated license plate reader (ALPR) cameras mapped in OpenStreetMap in a US or Canadian area of at most 3° per side, nearest the center first, with operator, manufacturer and facing direction.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_traffic_flow
title: Traffic flow
description: Live road traffic in a city-sized area from TomTom: average speed as a share of free-flow speed, congested and closed road length, and a breakdown by road category.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

name: get_weather_map
title: Weather map
description: The latest NOAA weather map image over an area: precipitation radar (contiguous US), regional or global infrared satellite clouds, or lightning density (the Americas). Returns the image itself.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

name: get_recent_imagery
title: Recent satellite image
description: The most recent clear satellite image of an area from NASA Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (30 m), falling back to the VIIRS daily overview. Areas up to 1000 km across. Returns the image itself.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

name: find_submarine_cables
title: Submarine cables
description: Undersea telecommunication cables and landing points from the TeleGeography map: those passing through or landing in an area, and/or those whose name matches.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: find_infrastructure
title: Datacenters and dams
description: Datacenters (with operator and capacity) or dams (with river and power output) mapped in OpenStreetMap within an area, nearest the center first.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_bhote_koshi_flood
title: Bhote Koshi flood
description: The 26 August 2026 Bhote Koshi outburst flood in Nepal as God's Eye View maps it: the evidence trail of geolocated public witness posts from the collapse to Devighat in story order, the mapped flood path, and the before and after satellite imagery. A visualization, not an official hazard model; capture times are unverified.

phase.description: Only evidence in a phase, such as "downstream passage".

name: get_cyclones
title: Tropical cyclones
description: Active tropical cyclones from the NOAA National Hurricane Center and Central Pacific Hurricane Center, optionally limited to an area.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

name: get_fire_perimeters
title: Wildfire perimeters
description: Mapped wildfire perimeters from the US WFIGS service in an area, largest first, with size, containment, cause and personnel.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_terrain_height
title: Terrain height
description: Ground elevation above sea level at up to 20 points, with the geoid and ellipsoid heights.

name: find_military_installations
title: Military installations
description: Military installations mapped in OpenStreetMap within an area of at most 10° on each side, nearest the center first.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: get_map_features
title: Map features
description: Named OpenStreetMap features at a location: the administrative areas containing it, named parks, land uses and water nearby, or monuments and memorials within 2.5 km.

location.description: A place name, or lat and lon.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 25, at most 200).

name: situation_brief
title: Situation brief
description: One overview of an area: current weather, recent earthquakes, active fires, aircraft overhead, ships and tropical cyclones, each summarized with its top items. Sections that are unavailable are marked as such.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

name: military_awareness
title: Military awareness
description: Military contacts around a location, as the military awareness panel shows them: military aircraft, other aircraft, ships and mapped military installations within 250 km by default, each nearest first. Sections that are unavailable are marked as such.

location.description: A place name, or lat and lon.

name: show_in_gods_eye_view
title: Show in God's Eye View
description: Shows a view in God's Eye View: in clients that display apps, the live God's Eye View globe in the conversation; everywhere, a link that opens it. Pass the view another answer returned, or describe one: an area framed from above or a camera position, with chosen data layers, visual style and map, optionally following an aircraft (or riding in its cockpit view) or a satellite, and with marks drawn on the map.

view.description: A view another answer returned (its data.view), shown as it is; other arguments given with it change that part of it.

area.description: Where to look. Give exactly one of: place (a name such as "Taiwan" or "San Francisco Bay"), bbox ([west, south, east, north] in degrees), or lat and lon with radius_km.

camera.description: Camera position: lat and lon it is above, altitude in meters, heading (0 is north) and pitch (-90 looks straight down, 0 at the horizon).

layers.description: Data layers to turn on, such as "flights" or "earthquakes".

style.description: Visual style: retro is CRT, surveillance is night vision, thermal is FLIR.

map.description: Map imagery; photoreal is Google 3D tiles.

annotations.description: Marks drawn on the globe: a pin, highlight, area or label at a place name (target) or lat/lon, an arrow between two points, or a route through points.

follow.description: An entity the camera follows: an aircraft or military aircraft by ICAO 24-bit address, or a satellite by NORAD catalog number. Its layer is turned on.

cockpit.description: Show the aircraft's cockpit view instead of following it from outside. Aircraft only; links open the app following it.

name: panel_request
title: God's Eye View panel request
description: Loads a file or data for the God's Eye View panel from the app's server. Only the panel calls this; it does not answer questions.

key.description: The panel's key, from its own page.

path.description: A path on the app's server, starting with /.

headers.description: Request headers; only Accept and Content-Type are sent.

id.description: Continue a response an earlier call returned in parts.
